Investments - Chalmers Ventures Investments - Chalmers Ventures × Contact us Investments Portfolio Program and Tracks Venture Building Programme The Mentorship Programme Tech Transfer Startup Camp Deep Tech 2026 Tech Matching Open Coaching Offers | Deals | Support Startup Stories News & Media News feed Newsletter Media Our team Contact About About CV Career Privacy policy Accessibility Statement Investments Portfolio Venture Building Startup Camp Deep Tech Tech Matching Team Menu Invest in a world-class dealflow of deep tech start ups The Chalmers Ventures portfolio consists of tech companies based on knowledge & research that resolve global challenges and offer great business potential . The portfolio includes companies at all stages of development. We invest in a wide range of industries, domains and applications. The goals of sustainability , profitability and equality are common to all. Investment Strategy Chalmers Ventures is an evergreen structure that invests in tech companies that resolve both global challenges and offer great business potential. Chalmers Ventures invests in early stages with the capacity to provide growth capital to selected companies. Chalmers Ventures is always looking to syndicate with other investors and has a large network of active players, from the very earliest stages to the later ones, leveraging the capital invested in the companies.
Investment Criteria Selection Chalmers Ventures invests in technology-based and innovative companies with growth potential.
